headline: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade is live on mainnet

scenes.vo: Solana just swapped out the engine that has run it since twenty twenty. The Alpenglow upgrade is live. Here's what changed.

On Wednesday morning, Solana's validators switched to Alpenglow, replacing the old Tower B F T system. Developer Anza says final confirmation drops from about thirteen seconds to around a hundred fifty milliseconds.
Here's why traders are watching it. Faster finality means exchanges and payment apps could treat Solana transactions as settled almost instantly.
The catch. That speed is Anza's own figure. Right after the switch, Solana's dashboard still showed about six seconds, and no independent measurement is out yet.
Here's what happens next. Watch real finality numbers over the coming days, network stability, and the next phase, called Rotor, which has no date yet.
